title: About this prototype
intro: HiveMind is a prototype for exploring people’s views and the reasons behind them. This page explains its current scope; it is not a final set of service terms.

sections.heading: What you can explore
paragraphs: Search original opinions and explore their model-estimated sentiment, or browse example discussions with positions and supporting reasons. The issue form lets you try submitting your own text and reopening it with a receipt.

sections.heading: Reading the examples
paragraphs: Example discussions demonstrate how exploration could work. Their contributions, positions and counts are illustrative. They are not measurements of national opinion.
Even when real contributions become available, the views submitted to a website do not by themselves establish what an entire population thinks.

sections.heading: What is still being developed
paragraphs: Submissions pass through an embedding model for related-text search and a sentiment model for the Positive, Negative and Neutral overview. Sentiment estimates tone, not support for the searched topic. Automatic topic organisation and position or reason analysis are not implemented yet, and submissions are not added to the example charts.
Operator details, contact information and policies for a public deployment remain to be established.
